name: roman-angel-bridge-pink-summer
image_purpose: Create a three-panel travel-fashion social collage at a historic Roman bridge.

prompt.project_info: UGC street-fashion outdoor-urban Rome travel-fashion triptych.
prompt.main_subject: Three original adult women presented as three related panels, with natural glowy makeup and distinct summer styling. Do not depict Madison Beer, Sydney Sweeney, Kendall Jenner or any other public-figure likeness.

Panel one: an original adult woman in a pastel pink strapless tiered ruffle mini dress, pearl necklace and sunglasses resting on her head, holding a small multitone graphic mini bag. Panel two: an original adult woman standing with one hand on the bridge balustrade, wearing retro black oval sunglasses and colorful beaded bracelets. Panel three: side view of an original adult woman with the angel statue clearly visible above, tourists in the background and a small graphic-printed mini bag held low. Show Castel Sant'Angelo, historic bridge architecture and blue sky.
